_comment: Machine-readable live-probe findings: facts the OpenAPI spec gets WRONG or cannot express, captured from real lab-tenant probing. The catalogue Decide stage reads these as authoritative overrides (live > openapi). One entry per OperationId. Fixture = the live response capture used for schema mapping. Only fields that the spec cannot yield are pinned here; everything else is derived.

ActionCenter.GetHistory.PageIndexStartReason: OpenAPI declares pageIndex default 0, which returns bodyless HTTP 500 on this endpoint; live-proven 1-based 2026-06-04 (pageIndex=1 -> 200 with rows). This endpoint family is 1-based.

ActionCenter.GetPending.PageIndexStartReason: ActionCenter pending-actions: pageIndex=0 returns a bodyless HTTP 500 (observed live in the FA 2026-06-10); same 1-based endpoint family as GetHistory (live-proven 1-based 2026-06-04). Set to 1; pending P2 live-confirm (pageIndex=1 -> 200 with rows).

VulnerabilityManagement.ListChangeEvents.PageIndexStartReason: tvm/analytics is 1-BASED — live-proven 2026-06-25 (Probe-TvmPaginationForm-Local: /changeEvents/ & /products ?pageIndex=1&pageSize=50 -> HTTP 200 echoing pageIndex:1; ?pageIndex=0 -> HTTP 400 'Wrong pagination parameters'; pageIndex=2 -> real page 2). Build-Catalogue default 0 emitted pageIndex=0 which the backend rejects (and the engine mislabeled UnsupportedApiVersion). Same 1-based family as ActionCenter.

VulnerabilityManagement.ListProducts.PageIndexStartReason: tvm/analytics 1-based (live-proven 2026-06-25 AND re-proven 2026-07-04 Probe-TvmPaginationForm-Local: /products ?pageIndex=1&pageSize=50 -> HTTP 200 (50 rows); ?pageIndex=0&pageSize=50 -> HTTP 400 'Wrong pagination parameters'; bare -> 20 rows echoing pageIndex:1). The OpenAPI spec declared ONLY pageIndex (no pageSize) so Build-Catalogue emitted Mode=none -> the connector single-paged 20 of ~51 products (DATA-INCOMPLETE, surfaced by the snapshot-dedup diagnosis). Added pageSize to the spec + PageIndexStart=1 here so the pageIndexIncrement loop fetches the COMPLETE product set each poll.

VulnerabilityManagement.ListAssetInstall.PageIndexStartReason: tvm/analytics 1-based (live-proven 2026-06-25 · same probe). assets/{assetId}/installations wrapper (numOfResults/pageIndex/results[]). The deployed pageIndex=0 was the 400 the engine logged as UnsupportedApiVersion; pageIndex=1 -> 200.

MultiTenant.GetTenantContext.NaturalKeyProvenReason: SNAPSHOT singleObject (tenant context · 1 row/cycle). Single-tenant connector -> OrgId is the stable per-tenant-org identity (live-derived JSON type=guid 2026-06-17 · OrgId='9c121001-7ee4-4aa7-9117-101000da3766' · 1 row/cycle => within-cycle count==dcount('OrgId')=1/1). Populates RecordId + makes the SNAPSHOT per-cycle dup-free verifiable. SAME mechanism as ExposureManagement.GetPostureOversightTenants (orgId).

SecureScore.GetInsights.CursorFieldProvenReason: BUCKETED-DATE CURSOR (a daily cohort TIME-SERIES, NOT a flat snapshot). createdDate is a per-DAY bucket — many insights share each date, so count != dcount('createdDate') by design (the per-record count==dcount cursor test does NOT apply here). LIVE-OBSERVED 2026-06-19: GetInsights returns a multi-day createdDate series (~30 insights per day) whose max advances daily, while the CURRENT day's cohort scores recompute intra-day (volatile). As a flat SNAPSHOT the whole-snapshot signature re-emits ALL ~2700 rows on ANY current-day change (live-caught dup-accumulation). Reclassified CURSOR-by-createdDate: the EO drops the frozen history (< high-water) and at the high-water (the current day) the KEYLESS boundary tie dedups by RecordId (the content-hash) — unchanged current-day rows drop, changed ones (new scores -> new content-hash) are kept. Exactly-once therefore comes from the RecordId boundary, NOT from cursor uniqueness.
SecureScore.GetInsights.IngestionModeProvenReason: CURSOR (bucketed-date). Keyless -> the runtime keyless-CURSOR RecordId-boundary path (Xdr.Common.Runtime.psm1 · F-KEYLESS-CURSOR 2026-06-20 · Select-XdrExactlyOnceRows + Get-XdrAdvancedFrontier fall back to RecordId when NaturalKey is empty) provides cross-cycle exactly-once. Proven live post-deploy by the C6 dup-accumulation gate (total <= dcount x bound). The classifier (Build-Catalogue) honors this explicit IngestionMode because the op name 'Insights' misses the history|audit|events|log|timeline keyword heuristic.
